rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for persistently insisting on doing V despite obstacles.

example.english: I will tenaciously insist on seeing them, no matter what happens.
example.traditional: 我死都要去見佢，天塌落嚟都唔改。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sei2 dou1 jiu3 heoi3 gin3 keoi5 tin1 taap3 lok6 lai4 dou1 m4 goi2

rows.note: Use this when someone keeps pursuing, pressing, or pestering someone relentlessly.

example.english: They tenaciously pestered the girl and made her very uncomfortable.
example.traditional: 佢死纏爛打咁追住個女仔，搞到人哋好困擾。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sei2 cin4 laan6 daa2 gam3 zeoi1 zyu6 go3 neoi5 zai2 gaau2 dou3 jan4 dei6 hou2 kwan3 jiu2

rows.note: Use this when the tenacity specifically consists of continuing an activity despite difficulty.

example.english: Even if I can never get the report right, I will tenaciously keep working on it.
example.traditional: 就算份報告改極都唔啱，我都會做落去。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 fan6 bou3 gou3 goi2 gik6 dou1 m4 ngaam1 ngo5 dou1 wui5 zou6 lok6 heoi3
